name: HITOP API Testing CLI
free_limit: MIT-licensed local Rust HTTP API testing CLI with file-based request collections, JavaScript scripting, Postman collection import, environment variables, and JUnit/JSON CI reports; no software subscription, seat quota or expiry.
watch_out: Free local CLI software, not a free hosted API or cloud testing allowance. Requires a user-managed machine or CI runner; target APIs, CI minutes and network usage may have separate limits or costs. Hosted web and app-store editions are separate offerings and are not included in this listing.
